SCT_Alex.name: Alex
SCT_Alex.notes: Working name. Brilliant, tender, observant and reflexively solution-oriented. Wants to protect love by understanding it and fears an ordinary or unrealized life. Arc: certainty -> comparison -> loss -> self-recognition -> embodied surrender -> presence. The writing must never imply that intelligence itself is the problem.

SCT_Mira.name: Mira
SCT_Mira.notes: Working name. Warm, grounded, intuitive and direct when boundaries matter. Her independent dream is a free-form community music-and-movement workshop where people do not need credentials, scores or perfection. She rejects being structured by someone else's fear, not structure itself.

SCT_City.name: The City / Ensemble
SCT_City.role: Chorus, crowd, memory field and social mirror
SCT_City.notes: Commuters, friends, strangers, café staff, clubgoers, workshop participants and memory-shapes. Begins as pressure and noise, ends as witness and community.

SCT_FormerLove.name: Former Love
SCT_FormerLove.notes: May remain unseen or be embodied by ensemble. Exists to reveal Alex's habit of comparison. Not a villain and not a plot antagonist.
